Question 1
?

Which of the following is equivalent to ∫C(x+y2)dx, where C is the path along the line segment from the point (−1,1) to the point (2,2), as shown above?

Hint: Use the parametrization r(t)=⟨3t−1,t+1⟩.

a
∫01(t2+4t+2)dt
b
3∫01(t2+5t)dt
c
∫01(t2+5t)dt
d
3∫01(t2+5t+2)dt
e
3∫01(t2+4t+2)dt
